summary.headline: Lunar Eclipses and Thunder Omens
summary.text: Lunar eclipse omens for December through March predict winter weather, famine, plague, harvests, and political upheaval among the Kaloitai and Persians. A new section, “Concerning thunders,” assigns omens to thunder heard on specific October and November dates, including deaths, locusts, flight, war, rain, frost, and royal events.
